name: PlainLaw - Legal Reference
subtitle: Law & Courts in Plain English
shortDescription: Free offline legal reference. 1,000+ legal terms, Know Your Rights guides, court directory, and more — all in plain English. No account needed.
longDescription:
PlainLaw is your complete legal reference companion, written in plain English for everyone — no law degree required.

### Pro Subscription
• Full US Constitution with annotations — all 27 amendments
  • Complete Federal Rules (FRCP & FRE)
  • 50 landmark SCOTUS cases with plain-English summaries
  • Federal court directory — all 94 district courts + 13 circuits
  • State court systems — all 50 states
  • Judicial profiles — current SCOTUS justices
  • International law — UN, ICC, UNCLOS, WTO, regional courts
  • 15-country legal profiles
  • Legal writing guide + citation formats
  • Circuit split tracker 
  • Practice area guides

PlainLaw is for individuals navigating legal situations, law students, paralegals, journalists, and anyone who wants to understand the law.
